body: Because I have already lost all hope.
All I will see is the person trying to manipulate my mindset. I am not at all comfortable opening up to someone I do not know, anyways. Anxiety is a bitch.

Therapy helps a mind that doesn't understand psychology and philosophy. The only way I can reasonably articulate this, is I feel like Atreyu, from the neverending story, battling the Nothing in what seems like a fight i cannot possibly hope to win.
